acceptance_reason: Baseline (Hybrid alone) retained as the served config: 42 controlled experiments (DANN variants, data-augmentation axes) were evaluated against it on 18-fold development LOSO and none cleared the one-standard-error acceptance bar. The legacy Random Forest ensemble is disabled in serving - the Hybrid network alone outperforms it, so this bundle serves Hybrid-only predictions.

per_subject_summary.note: Per-subject accuracy varies widely around the population mean (e.g. one subject reaches 80.7%, another falls to 44.9%) - the model estimates population-level reliability, not a personalized guarantee for any one person.
